title: Explicit native open tensor cochain specializations
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E of Q_ell, schemes X and Z in universe u and an open immersion j:X -> Z. Define SystemOpenCochainsData l E j to be OpenTensorCochainData [def-sf-open-tensor-cochain-data] on the ringed sequence sites with the actual positive-quotient VaryingRing extension, pullback, adjunction and pullSection of [def-coef-native-open-tensor-evaluation-data]. For n in N define FiniteOpenCochainsData l E j n to be that same structure on the pro-etale sites with the StrictTower extension, pullback, adjunction and finitePullSection at quotient stage n+1. These are transparent type abbreviations with all functors and instances explicitly specified; they assert no existence of data.
